title: synostemon pinifolius
intro: Synostemon pinifolius, commonly known as Native Holly, is a plant species native to Australia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, such as asthma and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Native Holly are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include terpenoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
